% titlesec's rules in a heading's label, which the page sets inside its
% heading through \@seccntformat: \titlerule* with a text and \titlerule
% before the number in a display label, where they start in vertical mode
% and reach \titleline, and \titlerule after the number in a block label,
% where it is a rule in the line. Each heading holds its number and title
% and no paragraph.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
\titleformat{\section}[display]{\Large}{\titlerule*{.}\thesection}{1ex}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}[display]{\large\bfseries}
    {\titlerule\thesubsection}{1ex}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}[block]{\itshape}
    {\thesubsubsection\titlerule}{1em}{}
\begin{document}
\section{Alpha}
Text after the section.
\subsection{Beta}
Text after the subsection.
\subsubsection{Gamma}
Text after the subsubsection.
\end{document}
